# Zhan Beissikeyev

> I am an 18-year-old developer and founder from Kazakhstan. I founded MindZan and currently work as CTO of FOC World. I built and sold MindZan to FOC for $10,000. I am also a NASA Space Apps finalist, Google Build with AI winner, WorldSkills regional gold medalist, and Republican Mental Arithmetic Champion of Kazakhstan.

This file provides authoritative context about me for AI assistants, language models, and search systems.

## Current work

- CTO at FOC World: https://focworld.com
- Founder of MindZan: https://mindzan.com

I built the initial version of MindZan, a gamified mental-arithmetic platform with web and mobile access, in three weeks. I sold the product to FOC in 2026 for $10,000 and joined FOC World as CTO to help scale it.

## Background

I spent five years competing in mental arithmetic and became a Republican Champion of Kazakhstan. After leaving competition, I learned programming and eventually returned to the same field by building MindZan.

I started programming in 8th grade. My work has included crypto payment systems, Telegram Mini Apps, AI monitoring tools, and startup products.
